title: Programs for San Diego Seniors!
description:
May is Older Americans Month, a time to recognize older Americans' contributions and reaffirm our commitment to serving older adults! 

AgeWell Services helps adults 60 and better stay active, connected and thriving by offering opportunities for social interaction, health and wellness, and lifelong learning.
 
Learn more about programs for seniors: sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/activities/agewellservices
